model_to_printer_matrix_note: 180 deg rotation about model +X axis, R = diag(1,-1,-1): (x,y,z) -> (x,-y,-z). Proper rotation, det=+1, no mirroring. Translation is Z-only, landmark-defined (bed-contact landmark plane -> printer Z=0); not a fixed numeric offset because final wall thickness is a CANDIDATE_BUILD decision, not a pre-design one.

edges.feature: cavity corner radius (F-002 / M-004), all 4 vertical corners
elephant-foot chamfer around the open-rim bed-contact loop

support_rules.region: camera-bar relief raised protective boss (F-003 relief), exterior back face
clearance-window roof bridges spanning <=25 mm (button, port, grille, mic reliefs) — 'fine' bridge class per fdm-design.md sec1, no support
support_rules.area_cap_note: per single window instance (span_mm x wall_thickness_mm, e.g. 25 x 1.6); not a summed budget across features

support_rules.region: volume-rocker/power-button window roof strip only, limited to the span exceeding 25 mm if the sheet's elongated-window strategy (M-021, approx 38 mm) is built unribbed
support_rules.footprint_note: bounded to the window opening's own roof strip only (nonfunctional pass-through clearance region, up to approx 38mm span x wall thickness); never the exterior cosmetic face and never the button-rocker contact pad
support_rules.activates_only_if: candidate chooses an unribbed window span > 25 mm; otherwise this rule is unused and S-02 governs

support_rules.region: all other candidate faces outside S-01/S-02/S-03 and the E-02 rim-chamfer landmark
